Consider the picture above. Given that $w=\lambda u+\mu v$, find $\lambda $ and $\mu .$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14258034/assets/fba4b74fde44c862267cd2c58852f4f829f5b07ead948b0c18d79e94f7d1c0fc.png)

In $△OUW$ shown above, we have 

- $OU=2|u|$

- $\overset{\to }{OU}$ and $u$ have the same direction

Hence, $\overset{\to }{OU}=2u.$

Similarly:

- $UW=3|v|$

- $\overset{\to }{UW}$ has the opposite direction to $v$

Hence, $\overset{\to }{UW}=-3v.$

Additionally, 

$$
\begin{aligned}w & =\overset{\to }{OU}+\overset{\to }{UW} \\  & =2u-3v.\end{aligned}
$$

Consequently, $w=\lambda u+\mu v=2u-3v.$

Since $u∦v,$ the linear combination can only be written in one way. Equating the coefficients, we get:

- $\lambda =2$ and $\mu =-3$
